The invitation

This is not theory.
It is remembering.

Over eight weeks, ninety minutes each week, you see how your patterns, your emotions and your choices connect to timeless universal principles. Through clear insight, honest reflection and real practice, you learn to work with the natural laws that shape your reality, your relationships and your growth. Not as something to study, but as something you recognise, because it is already true of you.

Why? Because the world is your mirror. This is the law of correspondence, and becoming aware of it, through the integration and remembrance of these laws, will help you far more in how you navigate through your life.

The 7 Universal Laws are not something outside of you. They are already at work within you.

The five elements

Five forms.
Five energies.

The seven universal laws and the five elements are one and the same light, seen from different sides. The laws show how life moves within you; the elements show the forms that movement takes. Throughout the program we keep looking at that one light from new perspectives, until the pattern underneath becomes your own.

The five Platonic solids are the shapes energy takes to become matter: earth, air, fire, water and aether. Always in motion, always within you.

The seven laws

Seven living forces.
One you.

Across the journey we move through each of the seven universal laws. Not as abstract ideas, but as forces you can feel, recognise and begin to live. One law each week.

01

Mentalism

"The All is Mind."

Everything begins as thought. Your inner world shapes the outer one. Reality is mental before it ever becomes material, so when you change the thought, you change what becomes possible.

02

Correspondence

"As above, so below."

The patterns within you mirror the patterns around you. Your outer life reflects your inner state, so you begin with what you carry, not with what you see.

03

Vibration

"Nothing rests, everything moves."

You are always sending out a frequency. Nothing stands still. You learn to feel your state, lift it, and meet life from a different place.

04

Polarity

"Everything has two poles."

Fear and courage, doubt and trust, are the same thing in degree. Once you see the scale, you can move along it, turning what blocks you into what carries you.

05

Rhythm

"Everything flows, out and in."

Life moves in tides. When you understand the swing, you stop fighting the ebb and learn to trust the return, working with your rhythm instead of against it.

06

Cause and Effect

"Every cause has its effect."

Nothing happens by chance. Every result has a root. You move from living at the mercy of life to consciously creating it.

07

Gender

"Two forces in everything."

The creative and the receptive live in everyone. Real creation is the balance of doing and allowing, knowing when to act and when to let life meet you.
